description: Høydedata Skred Sørum 2016 is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kartverket. Høydedata gir en detaljert beskrivelse av terreng og overflate. Dataene er etablert som punktskyer fra flybåren laserskanning eller matching fra flybilder. Punktskyene har varierende tetthet (punkt/m2 ) tilpasset ulike formål. Fra punktskyene er det generert høydemodeller på grid-format av terreng (DTM) og overflate (DOM). Coverage: Kartverket. The publisher named on the listing is Kartverket. Its keywords include Punktsky, Flybåren laser, Høyde, Høydemodell, Elevation, DOM. The listing shows 5 download or service links in OCTET, GEOTIFF, LAZ. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.geonorge.no/Geodataarbeid/Norge-digitalt/Avtaler-og-maler/Norge-digitalt-lisens/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
